invocation.required_environment: SystemRoot or SYSTEMROOT, TEMP and TMP are checked before anything is claimed (exit 79); the export round recorded this as an Advisory because its wrapper expanded them below the claim
invocation.root_overrides: retained mode refuses any set AGREEMENT_ROOT or REHEARSAL_PK, even empty
invocation.input_guard: every member of the plan inputs object is verified against its file before the claim, by verify_plan_inputs.py, exit 80; the plan is the single source of truth rather than a second set of wrapper constants
invocation.claim: atomic mkdir; an existing claim stays consumed; the script never removes one
invocation.claim_scope: a refusal before acquisition consumes nothing and leaves the packet callable once corrected; every failure after acquisition leaves the claim consumed and is never retried
exit_precedence: preconditions and record failures use their explicit codes, before any launch
after launch: a nonzero child status is returned unchanged
invocation.retained_file_inventory: the enumeration is captured and its status checked before any output is used, an empty enumeration is refused, and every regular file below the run root is listed in a stable order; rehearsal-red/ records the subdirectory defect and disposition.md records the silent-failure defect that a process substitution would have hidden

acceptance.primary: one real host session per hand, all 1,081 must classify as hit
acceptance.controls: off-pool must be chip-eligible and unsupported, CHECK-hit must hit, changed-stack must be chip-eligible with zero table hits
acceptance.census: the witness scan must cover every hand in the pool or the run fails
acceptance.schedule: every scheduled attempt reconciled against the admitted order
